title: Meiri on Shevuot — Hebrew Wikisource edition

sourceSeriesAuthorEvidence.finding: The selected series identifies BeitHaBechira as Menachem benShlomo of theMeir family. The Ketubot/BavaBatra/Avot introductions explicitly name the author. No contrary authorship attribution was found in the inspected selected pages; this is not a survey of disputes beyond those source pages.

attribution: Meiri on Shevuot, Menachem Meiri (Menachem benShlomo HaMeiri). Typed digital edition and editorial notes by Hebrew Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA4.0. Individual source revisions, source-page permalinks and contributor histories are recorded in source-manifest.json.
changes: Amudi removed only source navigation and parser edit controls, image/style/script tags and parser attributes, and made source/reference links absolute. Ordinary reader chapters contain flat text/HTML strings and are bounded to16000plain characters /32000markup characters per group. Exceptionally long HTML blocks are converted to escaped plain-text chunks at whitespace boundaries; all selected reading text, notes, variants and explicit source gaps remain conserved in source order. No OCR or new translation. Copyrightable Amudi adaptations remain CC BY-SA4.0.
coverageScope: All eight chapter reading pages of the selected typed Shevuot edition; source-specific omission notices remain recorded. Not a collation against every print.
